log_params_info: log the number of parameters, byte size, and shapes for a Haiku model
partition_params_by_name: partition Haiku parameters into two groups based on whether a key string appears in their name
partition_params_by_module_name: partition Haiku parameters into two groups based on whether a key string appears in their module name
merge_params: merge two sets of Haiku parameters into a single combined parameter set
make_opt: create an optax optimizer with optional gradient clipping, cosine decay schedule, or fixed learning rate
